name: Kuga Kyouichirou
source:
"My path... lies with you" 

 Rouga's best friend. He's also old friends with Kunagi and Gou. Has a cool personality, and possesses the ability to manipulate shadows. He's known as the Sword of Silhouettes. 

 Battle quote - "I won't let anyone stand in the way of our dreams!"
[Edited from [url=http://alicesoft.wikia.com/wiki/]Alice Soft wiki[/url]]
